fields.description: The registered legal name, exactly as it appears on the GST registration. GST Rule 46(a) requires this on the face of every invoice.
fields.label: Legal Name

fields.description: The name customers know you by, if it differs from the legal name. Printed under the legal name.
fields.label: Trade Name

fields.description: Your 15-character GSTIN. Its first two characters must match the state code below.
fields.label: GSTIN

fields.description: The full registered address, one line per line. Printed as-is on the invoice.
fields.label: Address

fields.description: The two-digit GST state code. This is what decides CGST+SGST versus IGST on every invoice, so it has to be right.
fields.label: State Code

fields.description: Invoice numbers are built as prefix + financial year + serial, for example INV/25-26/0001. GST Rule 46(b) allows at most 16 characters in total, so keep the prefix short.
fields.label: Invoice Number Prefix

fields.description: The SAC code new invoice lines start with. Verify it with your CA before you issue invoices.
fields.label: Default SAC Code

fields.description: Start new invoices in tour-package mode: 5% on the gross amount, no input tax credit, and the mandatory tour-operator statement printed on the invoice. Leave off to bill commission at the standard rate.
fields.label: Default To Tour Package Mode

fields.description: Your UPI address, for example agency@okbank. A payment QR code for the remaining balance is printed on every invoice PDF while this is set. No payment gateway is involved and no fee is charged.
fields.label: UPI ID (VPA)

fields.description: Printed at the foot of every invoice. One term per line.
fields.label: Terms

fields.description: The aggregate annual turnover above which GST e-invoicing (IRN) becomes mandatory. Seeded with the last figure this project could establish and left editable on purpose: confirm the current threshold with your CA.
fields.label: E-Invoicing Turnover Threshold

fields.description: Set automatically from the threshold above.
fields.label: Note
